completion_promises.criterion_text: Coach receives the rewritten response, not the original (covers @edge-case @verify @integration @coach-handover scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: Orchestrator now calls _apply_coach_handover() between Player.respond/revise and Coach.evaluate. The rewritten response (with citation annotations and stripped no-match quotes) is what is passed as player_response= to Coach.evaluate(). Verified by test_orchestrator_passes_rewritten_response_to_coach in tests/unit/knowledge/test_coach_handover.py: asserts coach_kwargs['player_response'] != original_response, contains '(5.1.35)' citation, and the fabricated quote string is stripped of its quote marks.

completion_promises.criterion_text: VerifierMetadata accompanies the rewritten response and is passed to the Coach evaluator (covers Group E coach-handover contract)
completion_promises.evidence: _evaluate_with_metadata() forwards verifier_metadata=metadata to Coach.evaluate when a handover is wired. test_orchestrator_passes_rewritten_response_to_coach asserts 'verifier_metadata' in coach_kwargs and isinstance(metadata, VerifierMetadata) with primary_matches and no_match_strips populated. apply_quote_verification returns (rewritten, VerifierMetadata) tuple as required.

completion_promises.criterion_text: AnalysisMode skip path sets retrieval_skipped_reason in metadata; Coach suppresses quote_fidelity down-rank for the turn (covers @key-example @smoke @retrieval @analysis-mode + TASK-DTL-002 acceptance criterion)
completion_promises.evidence: apply_quote_verification accepts retrieval_skipped_reason and forwards it through verify_quotes into VerifierMetadata.retrieval_skipped_reason on the success path; the exception path also preserves it. test_apply_quote_verification_forwards_retrieval_skipped_reason and test_orchestrator_forwards_retrieval_skipped_reason_in_analysis_mode confirm 'analysis_mode:no_primary_text' reaches Coach.evaluate's verifier_metadata kwarg unchanged. TASK-DTL-002's score_rubric was not modified per task scope; this seam delivers the data the existing rubric already consumes.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Verifier exception → unannotated response passed to Coach with empty VerifierMetadata and a verifier_exception flag; failure logged (covers TASK-DTL-002 acceptance criterion 'verifier-exception → unannotated')
completion_promises.evidence: apply_quote_verification wraps verify_quotes in try/except (broad catch is justified by the graceful-degradation contract). On exception it returns (original_response, VerifierMetadata(verifier_exception=True, retrieval_skipped_reason=...)) and logs at WARNING with structured 'event': 'coach_handover_verifier_exception'. Added verifier_exception: bool = False field to VerifierMetadata. Verified by test_apply_quote_verification_returns_original_on_verifier_exception, test_apply_quote_verification_preserves_skip_reason_on_exception, and test_orchestrator_continues_when_verifier_raises (which monkeypatches verify_quotes to raise and asserts result.decision == 'accept' with the original response and verifier_exception=True metadata).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Per-turn verifier_metadata is recorded in turn metadata (visible at session-end)
completion_promises.evidence: Added verifier_metadata: VerifierMetadata | None = None field to TurnResult dataclass (frozen so the recorded value is immutable post-turn). _build_result and all fallback paths (_fallback_coach_unreachable, _fallback_player_unavailable_mid_revision, exhaustion path) thread the relevant attempt's verifier_metadata into the TurnResult. _AttemptRecord also gained verifier_metadata so the lowest-scoring exhaustion path releases the matching metadata. Verified by test_orchestrator_passes_rewritten_response_to_coach (result.verifier_metadata is metadata) and test_orchestrator_runs_handover_on_each_revision (released attempt's metadata matches the accepted revision, not the first).

completion_promises.criterion_text: No regression to FEAT-PH1-003 — existing PlayerCoachOrchestrator tests still pass
completion_promises.evidence: coach_handover defaults to None on PlayerCoachOrchestrator.__init__; when None, _apply_coach_handover returns (raw_response, None) and _evaluate_with_metadata calls Coach.evaluate WITHOUT the verifier_metadata kwarg (preserving the FEAT-PH1-003 signature). Full pytest run: 689 unit + 4 smoke tests pass (all 56 tests in tests/unit/tutoring/test_orchestrator.py + tests/unit/knowledge/test_quote_verifier.py + new tests/unit/knowledge/test_coach_handover.py pass). test_orchestrator_without_handover_does_not_pass_verifier_metadata explicitly asserts 'verifier_metadata' not in coach_kwargs and result.verifier_metadata is None for legacy callers.

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: All four files compile cleanly under Python 3.12 (verified via successful import + 693-test pytest run). No new dependencies added. Code follows existing PEP 8 conventions in the repository: type hints with from __future__ import annotations, structured logging with extra=, pydantic v2 BaseModel patterns matching the surrounding modules, frozen dataclasses for immutable state, keyword-only constructor parameters. The only broad except in coach_handover.py is documented with the # noqa: BLE001 marker matching the orchestrator's existing boundary catches.
